sloka: न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्यः कार्दमेय महाबल ।संवत्सरोषितस्येह कारयिष्यामि ते हितम् ।। ७.८९.२० ॥
transliteration: na santāpastvayā kāryaḥ kārdameya mahābala ।saṁvatsaroṣitasyeha kārayiṣyāmi te hitam ।। 7.89.20 ॥

translations.english: O mighty son of Kardama, you should not feel any sorrow, for I shall ensure your well-being here after you have resided for a year.
